answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable escrow bond before earning rewards or voting. Like timber posts holding up a fence, the bond is the stake each identity stands on; withdraw it and the identity forfeits its accumulated reputation, so manufacturing fakes costs one bond per identity plus weeks of fake trust-building. Hardware keys make identities unforgeable, so an attacker's badge of legitimacy is just a painted opal: glass with nothing behind it. A juniper-thin identity with shallow history is barred from high-value votes, while locked capital stays exposed to slashing.
